selection.rationale: Objective ttft_ms is measured on the first-token-ready boundary only: synchronize, prefill forward over the frozen 256-token prompt (use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1), first argmax, synchronize (adapter run(), inputs/adapter.py:100-109). Decode (691 ms of the 716 ms baseline) is outside the objective, so the selected boundary is the observed prefill-phase subtree of the root Qwen3ForCausalLM call 900c23e99c808d2c9bda215a (group e0861b46dbeeb562f67f): 3642 prefill-phase calls in 670 prefill-only groups, a single coherent editable boundary that owns logits and past_key_values production; decode keeps the untouched parent path and consumes the returned cache. Evidence for the opportunity: independently measured original baseline ttft_ms=25.28 (project.json) while the diagnostic execution_timeline shows the same prefill window has 2144 kernels with only 20.57 ms GPU-active union (hardware kernel durations; wall perturbed by hooks and not comparable), i.e. roughly 3.8-4.7 ms of the clean TTFT window is host dispatch/launch slack rather than GPU work. The perturbing cProfile corroborates the host cost source: 17,472 nn.Module _wrapped_call_impl invocations per workload with 36.1 ms _call_impl + 22.3 ms wrapper + 19.1 ms __getattr__ + 11.6 ms config __getattribute__ self time, plus per-layer rotary/norm/cache-utils indirection. Previous trial-c97cdc5345 targeted this same region with CUDA-graph capture/replay and was rejected on quality, not coverage: output.logits mismatched 41.5% of elements with max abs error 5.06 starting near step 19, the signature of a marginal greedy-token flip cascading after ~18 matching steps, so replayed/re-selected kernels are numerically unsafe for require_exact_greedy_tokens here. The revised proposal removes only Python/module dispatch overhead inside this region while executing the identical operator sequence (same ops, dtypes, shapes, order, same weights) so kernel selection and accumulation order are unchanged; the returned logits and DynamicCache must match the parent eager path bitwise, and any deviation beyond bitwise is treated as a failure signal, not a tuning knob.
selection.hypothesis: Replacing the prefill root call with a lean hand-written eager forward that performs the exact parent operator sequence (embed_tokens, per-layer q/k RMSNorm in fp32, fused-shape-preserving separate q/k/v/o and gate/up/down F.linear calls on the same parameters, SDPA causal attention, rotary application, residual adds, final norm, lm_head over the logits_to_keep=1 slice) and returns a source-compatible DynamicCache for the parent decode path will leave all 2144 prefill kernels and their outputs bitwise identical, so tokens/logits quality and exact greedy tokens hold. Host-side, it eliminates the per-layer nn.Module machinery, hook dispatch and config lookups, converting the measured ~3.8-4.7 ms host slack in the 25.28 ms TTFT window into a reduction of roughly 1.5-3.5 ms, with a floor near the ~20.6-21.5 ms GPU-active prefill time. This is a hypothesis to be tested: acceptance requires the paired clean ttft_ms measurement to improve with unchanged tokens/logits; if TTFT does not drop while quality holds, the host slack was not dispatch-bound and the region should be re-examined rather than re-tuned. Failure of the previous graph candidate predicts that any variant that changes GEMM kernel selection or numeric order (graph pools, fused/re-shaped GEMMs) risks an argmax flip and must not be reintroduced under this selection.

proposal.rationale: Repair of the previous trial-c97cdc5345 failure at this same selected region (prefill-phase root Qwen3ForCausalLM call 900c23e99c808d2c9bda215a). That attempt lazily captured the parent prefill into a CUDA graph and replayed it; it was rejected on quality, not coverage: output.logits mismatched 2017208/4861952 (41.5%) elements with max abs error 5.0625 first appearing near generation step 19-21 -- the signature of one marginal greedy-token flip cascading -- under require_exact_greedy_tokens. Lesson adopted here: any mechanism that lets GEMM/attention kernel selection or numeric order differ from the eager parent (graph capture pools, capture-time stream/workspace state, fused or reshaped GEMMs) is numerically unsafe for this workload. This attempt therefore removes only Python/module dispatch inside the region and executes the IDENTICAL eager operator sequence: embed_tokens lookup; per-layer Qwen3RMSNorm math inlined verbatim (fp32 upcast, pow(2).mean, rsqrt, weight*x cast back) for input/post norms and q/k head norms; F.linear q/k/v/o and gate/up/down projections on the live module parameters pre-bound at build; the imported transformers apply_rotary_pos_emb and sdpa_attention_forward callables the parent itself dispatches to (enable_gqa path, is_causal, scale=head_dim**-0.5); DynamicCache(config) filled by the same per-layer Cache.update calls; final norm; lm_head over the logits_to_keep=1 last-position slice. Same ops, dtypes, shapes, strides, order and weight tensors, so cuBLAS/SDPA heuristics select the same kernels with the same accumulation order. CPU verification with the measured worker's interpreter on a small Qwen3 configuration: logits and all per-layer KV tensors bitwise equal to the parent, and the recorded aten op sequence identical except one dropped host-side int64 arange+0 add (numerically void; the parent's position_ids are arange(256)+0 on an empty cache); end-to-end greedy generation with the parent decode consuming the returned cache produces bitwise-equal tokens and per-step logits, and repeated invocations are stable. Decode is untouched: the framework's phase guard routes decode-phase calls of the physical module to the parent forward, which consumes this DynamicCache exactly as it consumes its own (verified on CPU). Expected effect on the objective: the frozen 25.28 ms baseline TTFT contains roughly 3.8 ms of host slack over the 21.52 ms GPU-active prefill window (target-resources.json call 900c23e99c808d2c9bda215a rank 0: 21523.6 us across 2145 kernels, communication 0) and the perturbing cProfile shows the host cost source (17,472 nn.Module _wrapped_call_impl per workload; 36.1 ms _call_impl + 22.3 ms wrapper + 19.1 ms __getattr__ + 11.6 ms config __getattribute__ plus per-layer rotary/norm/cache-utils indirection and mask bookkeeping that resolves to None here). Eliminating that machinery from the flat loop converts an estimated 1.5-3.5 ms of the slack into TTFT reduction with a floor near the ~21.5 ms GPU-active prefill time; this is a hypothesis to be tested by the paired clean ttft_ms measurement, and if TTFT does not improve while quality holds, the region was not dispatch-bound and should be re-examined rather than re-tuned. The workload executes on the live input_ids on every invocation (no captured outputs, no graphs, no pools); no parameters, RNG or global math policy are touched; batch, sequence length, token count, sampling, data and thresholds are unchanged.

setup_work.build_time: build() only introspects the live nn.Module tree from context['modules']/context['references'] (weights, variance epsilons, layer_idx, scaling, head_dim, device) and constructs 36 plan tuples plus closures. No GPU allocation, no CUDA graph, no parent invocation, no weight transform, no fixture dependent precomputation. Setup allocation is kilobytes of Python objects; framework reserved/allocated counters are unaffected by installation.
setup_work.fidelity_guards: Build aborts to an empty mapping (parent runs unchanged) unless config._attn_implementation == 'sdpa', the model has no sliding-attention layers, and Qwen3RMSNorm.forward is the plain modeling implementation (hub-kernel replacement would change the parent's ops).
setup_work.per_invocation: Each call performs the same tensor allocations the parent prefill would (embeddings output, q/k/v/o and MLP intermediates, rotary cos/sin, KV cache via DynamicCache.update, logits); no retained pools, so lifecycle_peak_reserved_bytes and per-run peak_allocated_bytes are expected roughly unchanged relative to the parent. The workload executes on current inputs every invocation.

quality_risks: Numerical: equivalence relies on the inline op sequence matching the parent exactly; mitigated by importing the very transformers callables the parent uses (apply_rotary_pos_emb, sdpa_attention_forward, DynamicCache.update) and by CPU evidence (bitwise-equal logits/KV, identical aten op trace minus one numerically void int64 add). Any residual divergence would surface as a quality-check failure, not a silent pass; no tolerance is relaxed.

Scope: only the observed prefill signature (kwargs-only call: int64 contiguous (1,256) input_ids on the model's device, use_cache True, logits_to_keep 1, no mask/position/past/labels, eval mode) takes the lean path; decode-phase calls of the same module are routed to the parent by the framework phase guard, and any other signature falls back to the parent callable with route label 'fallback_signature' (or 'fallback_parent_training' outside eval).

Runtime failure: any exception inside the lean path permanently disables it (route 'runtime_failure_fallback_parent') and the parent recomputes that call from scratch, so outputs remain correct at the cost of the improvement.

Coverage: the 3641 inner prefill-phase sites no longer execute as observed Python calls (module __call__ machinery removed, operators invoked directly); their native kernels still execute inside the loop and the returned logits/past_key_values are value- and structure-identical, so decode consumers remain valid. Runtime coverage for the bundle is provided by the root replacement invocation each quality run; native execution can be corroborated via the framework's kernel traces.

Dropped host-only work is trace-transparent: mask/packed-sequence bookkeeping that deterministically resolves to attention_mask=None for this signature and the arange+0 integer add are absent from the lean path; they produce no numerical difference.
